recheck.text: What legalMoves, applyMove and status do when the FEN argument is missing, not a string, malformed (empty, wrong number of ranks or squares in a rank, unknown piece letter, bad side-to-move or other field, trailing whitespace or newline) or syntactically valid but an impossible position (a side with no king or two kings, a pawn on the first or eighth rank, the side not to move already in check).

defects.title: Malformed FENs are accepted and given confident wrong answers instead of an error
defects.repro: const c=require('./src/chess.js'); c.status('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR x KQkq - 0 1'); c.legalMoves(same); c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/9/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1','e2e4'); c.legalMoves('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNX w KQkq - 0 1'); c.applyMove(c.startFen().replace('KQkq','XYZ'),'e2e4')
defects.observed: side 'x': status 'stalemate', legalMoves []; 9-square rank: returns 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/97/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq e3 0 1'; unknown piece 'X': 20 moves and 'X' echoed into the next FEN; castling 'XYZ' echoed into the output FEN
defects.expected: a thrown, descriptive error (Error/TypeError/an invalid-FEN class) for a FEN that is not well-formed, never a status or a new FEN

defects.title: Garbage FEN input surfaces internal TypeErrors with no description of the problem

defects.expected: an error whose message says the FEN is invalid (and which part)
